correctness.rationale: All-parameter proof via classification of forest column configurations on a three-vertex side; exact formulas for Z, U and all three orbit-specific joint weights; polynomial certificates Δ_R=x^4(b-1)P_R, Δ_D=x^4P_D, Δ_L=Δ_D+x^4a²H_b with manifestly strictly positive factors for b≥2, x>0. Standalone standard-library union-find census and rigorous degree-bounded polynomial-interpolation algebra replayed 308 exact comparisons. Finite graph checks are not used as proof of the infinite size statement.

originality.rationale: Qualifying new family is all K_{3,b}, b≥3 non-series-parallel and all positive common edge fugacities, with three explicit pair-orbit certificates. Existing reviewed general results were a conjecture, a series-parallel proof, finite census, all-graph high-fugacity partial results, and a K_n-only result.
